content: The chapter says surviving correspondence from Ibn Turka to Iskandar attests their total alliance, and that Iskandar was defeated and executed only five years into his reign by his conservative, Sunnizing uncle Shāhrukh (r. 811-850/1409-47), who preferred Seljuq-style sultanship to occult philosopher-kingship. Footnote 24: Iskandar did not live to see the Mafāḥiṣ completed, but Ibn Turka clearly began working on it in response to his interest.
